name: Pumps
scope: One complete 500 mm board-to-motor-tab harness, its Faston end finished through front-top's lead bore with the box closed and the funnel frame out
mapStatus: Circuit and pair order follow the assembly schedule. The white-striped edge is assigned to AM2 as a bench convention; it is not a record of an assembled sample.
overview: Four separate motor conductors run from the J13 JST plug to four insulated female Faston receptacles on the two pumps' motor tabs. The +X pair serves pump A and the −X pair pump B.
overviewFacts: 4 insulated female Fastons · two per pump

ribbons.description: A1 is the white-striped edge and lands on AM2. Count away from it: A2 AM1, A3 BM2, A4 BM1. Peel the pump end into its two pairs back 70 mm, A1/A2 for pump A and A3/A4 for pump B, and part each pair's last 20 mm.

pins.detail: Striped A1 joins J13 cavity 1 / AM2 to pump A's motor tab 2. This is one H-bridge motor lead, not a shared supply.
A2 joins J13 cavity 2 / AM1 to pump A's motor tab 1. Keep it separate from AM2 and both pump-B conductors.
A3 joins J13 cavity 3 / BM2 to pump B's motor tab 2. It carries one pump-B motor lead straight to its tab.
A4 joins J13 cavity 4 / BM1 to pump B's motor tab 1. It is the ribbon's −X edge in the lead bore and the lead slot.

conductors.title: J13 AM2 → pump A motor tab 2
conductors.toPart: Insulated female Faston receptacle · matched to the motor tab
conductors.note: White-striped A1, the ribbon's +X edge in the lead bore and the lead slot. It turns +X with A2 along pump A's crown groove.

conductors.title: J13 AM1 → pump A motor tab 1
conductors.toPart: Insulated female Faston receptacle · matched to the motor tab
conductors.note: Second conductor counted from the white stripe. It turns +X with A1 along pump A's crown groove.

conductors.title: J13 BM2 → pump B motor tab 2
conductors.toPart: Insulated female Faston receptacle · matched to the motor tab
conductors.note: Third conductor counted from the white stripe. It turns −X with A4 along pump B's crown groove.

conductors.title: J13 BM1 → pump B motor tab 1
conductors.toPart: Insulated female Faston receptacle · matched to the motor tab
conductors.note: Fourth conductor counted from the white stripe, the ribbon's −X edge. It turns −X with A3 along pump B's crown groove.

dress.description: No sleeves, collars or ties. The 4P ribbon stays bare along the bulkhead crown, through the lead bore and up the clamp's lead slot; each pair lies bare in its crown groove.
dress.qualification: Feeding the free end through the lead bore precedes the Faston crimps. Landing the Fastons, dressing the leads, seating the pump cradle and installed routing are separate assembly jobs.

materials.label: Cable
materials.detail: 500 mm BNTECHGO 22 AWG black 4P silicone ribbon

materials.label: Other end
materials.detail: 4 insulated female Faston receptacles from the §11 kit, matched to the motor tabs

materials.label: Tools
materials.detail: Stripper · SN-2549 JST crimper · Haisstronica insulated-terminal crimper · flush cutters · multimeter

steps.title: Cut & identify
steps.instruction: Cut one 500 mm 4P ribbon. Call the white-striped edge A1 / AM2, then count A2 / AM1, A3 / BM2 and A4 / BM1. Peel the pump end into its two pairs back 70 mm, A1/A2 for pump A and A3/A4 for pump B, and part each pair's last 20 mm.

steps.title: Crimp the JST end
steps.instruction: Splay and strip the four JST ends. Crimp four SXH-001T-P0.6 contacts, inspect the conductor and insulation barrels, then seat A1–A4 in XHP-4 cavities 1–4. Match cavity 1 to the native PCB AM2 label and the housing circuit-1 mark.

steps.title: Crimp the Fastons
steps.instruction: With the box closed and the funnel frame out, feed the free pump end forward through front-top's lead bore and out of the empty bay. Strip the four ends and crimp four insulated female Faston receptacles, matched to the motor tabs' width. Inspect and tug each crimp.

steps.title: Ring out & label
steps.instruction: With the XHP-4 unplugged and the Fastons not yet landed, ring out each XHP-4 cavity to its Faston and check all six pairs for isolation. Check contact retention. Label the housing J13 · PUMPS and stage the piece for the pump cradle's installation.

estimateBasis: 5 attended minutes per finished J13 at unit 25: 0.5 minute to cut, identify and split the pump end, 1.5 minutes for four JST crimps and housing insertion, 2 minutes to feed the free end through the lead bore and crimp four insulated Fastons, and 1 minute to ring out and label. One practiced person completes the piece start to finish with the map, materials and hand tools ready, the box closed and the funnel frame out; shared setup is amortized. Ten minutes is the upper planning allowance. This is a theoretical, unmeasured estimate. It excludes development and lookup, landing the Fastons, seating the pump cradle and cabinet routing.

sources.label: Lead bore, lead slot and crown grooves
